|gr1= Markers

|arg= global

|descr= Returns the size of the given marker. A getter for [[setMarkerSize]] and an alias of [[markerSize]].

|s1= [[getMarkerSize]] markerName

|p1= markerName: [[String]]

|r1= [[Array]] with [a_axis, b_axis]
* a_axis: [[Number]] - 1/2 width of marker
* b_axis: [[Number]] - 1/2 height of marker

|x1= <sqf>
"MarkerOne" setMarkerSize [100,200];
_size = getMarkerSize "MarkerOne"; //returns [100,200]
</sqf>
